description: Domain registration (RDAP): Registration, expiry and last-changed dates, status flags, nameservers, registrar and DNSSEC for a domain from the registry's RDAP service (IANA bootstrap via rdap.org, free, no key). Source: registry RDAP. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: registered, registration_date, expiration_date, days_to_expiry, status[], nameservers[], registrar, dnssec, source.
name: x420_domain_rdap
